mapper.insert: INSERT INTO matching_results (estimate_request_id, contractor_id, match_score, match_rank, status) VALUES (#{estimateRequestId}, #{contractorId}, #{matchScore}, #{matchRank}, COALESCE(#{status}, 'RECOMMENDED'))
mapper.select: SELECT m.id, m.estimate_request_id, m.contractor_id, m.match_score, m.match_rank, m.status, m.created_at, c.id AS c_id, c.company_name AS c_company_name, c.career AS c_career, c.average_rating AS c_average_rating, c.review_count AS c_review_count, c.preferred_types AS c_preferred_types, c.service_area AS c_service_area, u.profile_image AS c_profile_image, u.nickname AS c_nickname FROM matching_results m JOIN contractors c ON c.id = m.contractor_id JOIN users u ON u.id = c.user_id WHERE m.estimate_request_id = #{estimateRequestId} ORDER BY m.match_rank ASC

SELECT c.id, c.user_id, c.company_name, c.career, c.certifications, c.preferred_types, c.service_area, c.introduction, c.portfolio_images, c.average_rating, c.review_count, u.nickname, u.profile_image FROM contractors c JOIN users u ON u.id = c.user_id WHERE c.is_banned = 0 AND u.is_banned = 0
AND (c.preferred_types IS NULL OR c.preferred_types = '' OR FIND_IN_SET(#{designCode}, REPLACE(c.preferred_types, ' ', '')) > 0)
ORDER BY c.average_rating DESC, c.review_count DESC, c.career DESC LIMIT 50
